storyCards.headline: Take Me Home Country Roads: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
John Denver's "Take Me Home Country Roads" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 23 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "John Denver's Greatest Hits" (1973) — not the song's original release year.
